web_addons.removal: Inventory usage, licenses, transitive dependencies and CI impact before removal; never bulk-delete blindly.

language_architecture.boundary: Versioned stable C ABI; never force a language into targets that cannot support it.

adapters.ruby_driver_workflows: Host-side inventory, build, test and evidence automation; Ruby is never a kernel-mode driver.
adapters.drivers: Target-specific signed least-privilege interfaces; no automatic installation or mutation.
adapters.games: Optional host-process orchestration with executable allowlists and explicit user consent.
adapters.pe_xe_gui: Format-specific artifact pipeline and GUI integration; PE/COFF is distinct from an unspecified XE format.
adapters.lua: Optional sandboxed scripting with bounded CPU, memory, file and process capabilities.

google_adaptive_backend.mode: optional provider adapter, not a hard dependency
controls: secrets from environment or secret store only
no silent telemetry or code execution

adapters.swift_assembly: Optional interop/performance layer only after ABI, compiler and target-ISA qualification.

truthfulness.rule: A manifest is not evidence that a runtime adapter, driver or target build is implemented.

repository_profile.role: Elbrus/E2K architecture research and platform qualification
in_scope: assembly only after vendor toolchain and ISA verification
out_of_scope: claiming E2K support without target evidence
repository_profile.integration_note: All architecture claims remain evidence-backed; host results cannot be promoted to target qualification.
